title: Capillary & EHD Liquid Bridges Between Cylinders
description: Multi-boundary axisymmetric BEM modeling of an electrohydrodynamic liquid bridge anchored between two cylindrical electrodes ($+V_0$ and $-V_0$). Dynamic simulation traces the fluid deformation flow speed $|u|$ coupled with the continuation bifurcation diagram ($B_e = 12.0, B = 0.5, d = 0.5, \theta_0 = 15^\circ$) mapping bridge height $H_b = z_1(0) - z_2(0)$ versus cross-sectional area $A$ up to turning-point limit ($A_{\text{max}} = 12.09$).
